test_title: PYST 17: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 12 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a dimension measured by the Gender Inequality Index (GII)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Access to clean drinking water**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Gender Inequality Index (GII) is a composite index measuring disparities in achievements between men and women in three dimensions: reproductive health, empowerment, and labor market participation.
 
• **Reproductive health** is measured by maternal mortality ratio and adolescent birth rates.
 
• **Empowerment** is measured by the proportion of parliamentary seats held by women and the proportion of women and men aged 25 years and older with at least some secondary education.
 
• **Labor market participation** is assessed by the labor force participation rate of women compared to men.
 
• Access to clean drinking water is not considered a dimension in the Gender Inequality Index, as GII focuses on gender-specific inequalities rather than general living conditions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gender Inequality Index (GII):**

 
 
• Introduced by the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) in its 2010 Human Development Report.
 
• It highlights areas where women are disadvantaged compared to men.
 
• The GII ranges from 0 (no inequality) to 1 (complete inequality).
 
 
 
• **Reproductive Health Indicators:**
 
 
• Maternal mortality ratio: The number of maternal deaths per 100,000 live births.
 
• Adolescent birth rate: The number of births per 1,000 women aged 15-19 years.
 
 
 
• **Empowerment Indicators:**
 
 
• Proportion of parliamentary seats held by women: Reflects political representation and decision-making power.
 
• Educational attainment: Tracks the percentage of women and men with at least some secondary education.
 
 
 
• **Labor Force Participation:**
 
 
• Compares the percentage of women and men actively engaged in the labor market.
 
• It includes both employed individuals and those actively seeking employment.
